purpose: Acknowledge two newly identified precursors and authorize preparation only of a versioned novelty-control amendment, narrowed claim text, additive specifications, deterministic fixtures and expected-red tests. This candidate does not amend or freeze the plan, install dependencies, change production code, execute an optimizer/evaluator or consume formal FFE.

decision_R_historical_precursor.meaning: Accept Ray, Tai and Seow 2000 as a high-risk adjacent precursor for per-constraint non-overlap/complementary mate selection. Do not describe I3 as the first complementary constraint-signature mating method.

decision_M_conceptual_precursor.meaning: Accept Ming, Wang and Zhang 2021 as a conceptual precursor for pairwise constraint-relationship identification and grouping. Do not describe I3 as the first method to model or exploit relationships among constraints.

decision_C_amendment_scope.meaning: Prepare an additive versioned plan amendment proposing the new control and claim boundary. Historical frozen files remain immutable and the amendment is ineffective until a separate hash-bound freeze authorization.

decision_B_required_control.meaning: Propose a clean-room, same-parent, equal-FFE control that selects complementary mates by per-solution constraint-satisfaction set overlap, based only on the public Ray et al. mathematical mechanism.
required_fairness_contracts: Use the same selected parent mechanics, initialization, bounds, constraint residual order/sign, selection, stopping, seed policy and paired FFE ledger as I3.
Do not copy source code; translate only the public algorithmic concept into a project specification after parent identity is separately resolved.
Do not use a graph, graph community, co-violation matrix or graph-derived donor identity in this control.
Define deterministic tie-breaking and exact base-RNG draw continuity.
Keep activation/applicability and fallback bookkeeping comparable to I3 without adding hidden evaluations.

decision_N_claim_scope.candidate_claim: I3 tests whether a population-conditioned constraint co-violation community signal contributes information to constrained SHADE difference-donor topology beyond non-graph complementary constraint-signature mating and diversity-matched controls.
prohibited_claim_families: first use of per-constraint patterns for mating
first use of non-overlapping constraint satisfaction
first identification, grouping or exploitation of constraint relationships
objective novelty or performance superiority is established

required_red_coverage: feasible/infeasible and empty/full overlap boundary cases
no graph or community input to the control
paired objective-plus-full-constraint FFE accounting with evaluator forbidden during red/static phase
result schema distinguishes I3, Ray-style, diversity-matched, rewired and random-label controls
plan and claim text retain novelty UNKNOWN until authorized experiments and analysis
decision_T_tdd_scope.phase_boundary: Only specification, fixtures and expected-red/static tests become eligible after exact author confirmation. No production implementation or evaluator access is included.

authorization_effect_if_confirmed: Record Ray 2000 as a high-risk adjacent precursor and Ming 2021 as a conceptual precursor.
Prepare a versioned additive novelty-control amendment without freezing or activating it.
Prepare narrowed claim language that does not assert objective novelty or performance.
Prepare additive specifications, deterministic fixtures and expected-red/static tests for the Ray-style and graph-specific negative controls.
Run only the newly authorized expected-red/static tests with all evaluator access forbidden and formal FFE fixed at zero.
Prepare a separate hash-bound amendment freeze or production-implementation candidate for later author confirmation.
not_authorized_even_if_confirmed: Editing or replacing historical frozen Stage 4, Stage 5 or Stage 6 snapshots.
Freezing or activating the novelty-control amendment.
Resolving, freezing or importing the pending M/H, parent-identity or modern-benchmark/external-baseline decisions by inference.
Installing or downloading any package, benchmark or source code.
Changing production optimizer, evaluator, adapter, benchmark or existing test code beyond the separately prepared additive red-test files.
Calling an objective, constraint, benchmark, optimizer or evaluator.
Executing S6-E0, M/C1/F/C2, Stage B, full TCAC or any formal FFE.
Forming novelty, effectiveness, superiority, convergence, robustness or paper-readiness conclusions.
Public release, remote push, submission or publication.
